chart.name: % cache used
chart.programText:
A = data('df.cache.free').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('df.cache.used').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/(A+B)).scale(100).mean().publish(label='C')

chart.name: Total connections
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_connections.current', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached')).sum().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Hosts reporting
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_connections.current', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached')).sum(by=['host']).count().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Top hosts sets/sec
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_command.set',rollup='rate').publish(label='A')

chart.name: Hit rate
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_ops.hits', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('memcached_ops.misses', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'),rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/(A+B)).scale(100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Lowest hit rate
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_ops.hits',rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('memcached_ops.misses',rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/(A+B)).bottom(count=5).scale(100).mean(by=['host']).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Total items
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_items.current').sum().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Sets/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_command.set', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: Top hosts gets/sec
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_command.get',rollup='rate').publish(label='A')

chart.name: Network bits/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_octets.tx',rollup='rate').sum().scale(8).publish(label='A')
B = data('memcached_octets.rx',rollup='rate').sum().scale(8).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Total evictions/sec
chart.programText: A = data('memcached_ops.evictions',rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Gets/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_command.get', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: Sets/sec vs evictions %
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_command.set', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('memcached_ops.evictions', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*B/A).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Cache size

B = data('df.cache.used', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Items 1h change %
chart.programText:
A = data('memcached_items.current', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('memcached_items.current', filter=filter('plugin', 'memcached')).timeshift('1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A/B-1).publish(label='C')
